कुबे(वे)रः
[कुत्सितं बे (वे) रं शरीरं यस्य सः] 
__1 The god of riches and treasure and the regent of the northern quarter; कुबेरगुप्तां दिशमुष्णरश्मौ गन्तुं प्रवृत्ते समयं विलङ्ध्य [[Ku. 3. 25]] (vide [[Malli.]] thereon). [Kubera is the son of Viśravas by Iḍāviḍā, and thus the half brother of Rāvaṇa. Besides, being the lord of riches and regent of the north, he is the king of the Yakṣas and Kinnaras, and a friend of Rudra. His abode is Kailāsa. He is represented as being deformed in body-having three legs, only eight teeth, and a yellow mark in place of one eye.] 
__2 N. of a tree. 
-Comp. 
-अक्षी N. of a plant (Mar. सागरगोटी). 
-अद्रिः, -अचलः an epithet of mountain Kailāsa. 
-दिश् f. the north. 
-बान्धवः N. of Śiva.

a. [कु ईषत् उब्जमार्जबं यत्र शकं° [[Tv.]]] Hump-backed, crooked. अन्धाः खञ्जाः कुब्जा बामनकाश्च [[Garbha. Up. 3.]] 
-ब्जः 
__1 A curved sword. 
__2 A hump on the back. 
__3 A sort of fish; [[Mb. 7. 56. 8.]] 
-ब्जा A young female servant of Kaṃsa, said to be deformed in three parts of her body. [Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma, while proceeding to Mathurā, saw her on the high road carrying unguent to Kaṃsa. They asked her if she would give them some portion of it, and she gave as much as they wanted. Kṛṣṇa, being very much pleased with her kindness, made her perfectly straight, and she began to appear a most beautiful woman.] 
-Comp. 
-किरातः -वामनः a. hump-backed person and a dwarf. 
-गामिन् a. going crookedly, going astray; बुद्धयः कुब्जगामिन्यो भवन्ति महतामपि [[Pt. 2. 5.]] 
-लीला the manner, gait or character of a hump-backed person; [[Ś. 2.]]
An unmarried girl of eight years old.

__1 A forest. 
__2 A hole for sacrificial fire. 
__3 A ring; an ear-ring. 
__4 A thread. 
__5 A cart.

कूब(व)र
a. 
(-री f.) 
__1 Beautiful, agreeable. 
__2 Hump-backed, 
-रः, -रम् The pole of a carriage to which the yoke is fixed; ततः स मथिताष्टाश्वं रथं भग्नाक्षकूबरम् [Page0593-2] [[Rām. 5. 46. 28.]] (द्विकूबरम्) [[Bhāg. 4. 26. 2.]] 
-रः A hump-backed man. 
-री 
__1 A carriage covered with a cloth or blanket. 
__2 The pole of a carriage to which the yoke is fixed; [[Ve. 4.]]; अंसेन संश्लिष्य च कूबराग्रम् [[Bu. Ch. 3. 60.]] 
-Comp. 
-स्थानम् the seat on a carriage.
